connector.name: MCP by butterbase-ai
connector.registryDescription: Butterbase MCP server - manage your backend: schemas, auth, functions, storage, RAG, deploys.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.butterbase.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the butterbase-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
